description: Lab 3 Section 4 'Correctness & Negative Tests', bundled under the common --kat runner. Layout: positive correctness first, then the five mandated negative cases, then fail-closed parsing. All cryptographic values are generated on-the-fly inside the runner so each test is self-contained; no fabricated NIST vectors.

tests.name: [NEG-1] Altered RSA ciphertext must fail (Lab 3 Sec.4 case 1)
[NEG-2] Altered AES-GCM ciphertext must fail (Lab 3 Sec.4 case 2)
[NEG-3] Wrong private key must fail (Lab 3 Sec.4 case 3)
[NEG-4] Wrong OAEP label must fail (Lab 3 Sec.4 case 4)
[NEG-5] Tampered envelope header (GCM tag) must fail (Lab 3 Sec.4 case 5)
[CLOSE-1] Malformed envelope JSON must fail closed
[CLOSE-2] Modulus < 3072 must be refused at keygen
